atropine.t: Hypersensitivity to atropine or any of its derivatives
Ipratropium Bromide Nasal Solution 0.03% (Nasal Spray) is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to atropine or its derivatives, or to any of the other ingredients.

albuterol.t: With the exception of albuterol, there are no formal studies fully evaluating the interaction effects of ipratropium bromide HFA inhalation aerosol and these drugs with respect to safety and effectiveness.
